note: Allowlist manifest for verify/compare_manifest.py: every file the integration branch adds or changes, with the SHA-256 of the verified source bytes (looked up by source_path or path under the backup trees). A file is accepted only if the candidate holds what the declared line-ending policy makes of those bytes. Additions, changes AND removals are checked against the reference: the original baseline commit (baseline_head). A baseline file absent from the candidate fails unless it is listed under deleted (none is planned). Protected names never appear here.
